notes: C-bb7cec38 (fit a parametric bayesian network over the discovered structure): recover a tree DAG by maximum-|Pearson-correlation| Prim spanning tree oriented away from a declared root, then fit linear-Gaussian CPDs (population-moment OLS intercept/slope/residual sigma, plus root mean/sd) under the recovered structure. The verifier re-executes the solver on three hidden datasets with different column names, network sizes and coefficient regimes, checks edges against an in-process reference, holds every coefficient to a tight tolerance, and runs a two-sample KS resampling test (simulating from the agent's own parameters against the observed columns, threshold 0.035) so inaccurate fits shift the resampled distribution and fail.
